messages:
rachel (People Ops): follow-up from today's all-hands reorg segment. keeping this thread short — drop one-line Qs and we'll reply.
kevin (CEO): high-level: hiring focus shifts to infra, runtime performance, and enterprise features that unblock private deployments.
tara (Head of Eng): to be explicit: consolidation reduces overlapping ownership. goal = 12 squads from 17 org groups over 60 days. not a headcount cut.
matt (SWE): will sprint work be paused for handoffs? we already have tight deadlines.
tara (Head of Eng): no pause. handoffs are phased across milestones; owners keep current sprint commitments for the next two cycles.
samir (VP Infra): infra/SRE roles get priority gating for SLA work. please flag reqs with "infra-priority" label.
jules (Recruiter): process note: flagged reqs -> fast-track posting (3 business days). regular reqs -> ~10 business days. include two success metrics in the req.
anya (Eng Manager): manager hires — are we hiring more people managers or leveling up ICs?
kevin (CEO): in most cases prefer senior ICs. manager hires only when they clearly enable >2x team throughput or are needed for compliance.
rachel (People Ops): internal mobility window will open 5 business days after we publish the mapping doc. leaders must post open roles to #internal-moves.
matt (SWE): contractors — allowed for experiments? some teams need quick help for demos.
tara (Head of Eng): short-term contractors (<=12 weeks) allowed for trial projects or demos. ownership roles should be FT.
reorg-bot: Reminder: submit any hiring objections by EOD Friday per the governance doc.
jules (Recruiter): quick tip: attach a short hiring brief (1 paragraph) that explains why role is prioritized — helps approvals.
kevin (CEO): budget update: we reallocated three non-core headcount slots to platform work. that enables ~5 immediate infra reqs.
anya (Eng Manager): will there be a public mapping so people can check where they're listed?
rachel (People Ops): yes 2 we2ll publish the mapping with flags: retained / open / under-review and a short rationale.
matt (SWE): curious how this affects IC career ladders — any changes to leveling?
kevin (CEO): no immediate leveling changes. we'll surface leveling updates separately if needed.
rachel (People Ops): we'll compile this Q&A into a short FAQ and attach to the all-hands notes. DM me or @jules for private follow-ups. :wave:
